title: leucanthemum pachyphyllum
intro: Leucanthemum pachyphyllum, commonly known as the Chrysocoma or more specifically, the Tarchonanthus pachyphyllus, is a plant species within the Asteraceae family. This plant is traditionally used to treat various health issues, and it is known to have health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help in soothing digestive issues and reducing oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Leucanthemum pachyphyllum include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it effective in treating wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
